# Analysis {#analysis}

Just to see how the code blocks appear.

```{python}
#| label: crossing-times
#| code-fold: show

ducks = pd.DataFrame({
    "lamp": ["Still", "Still", "Swiveled", "Swiveled"],
    "seconds": [12, 14, 9, 11],
})

mean_times = ducks.groupby("lamp")["seconds"].mean()
for lamp, seconds in mean_times.items():
    print(f"{lamp}: {seconds:.1f} seconds")
```
